name: bind_without_identity
invariant: Bind makes a dependency between two objects observable without identifying them: both remain distinct, uncommitted members of Omega.
explanation: A snapshot that only stored 'object 1' after binding 1 and 2 would be indistinguishable from never having bound anything. Bind's effect is only visible in the append-only history (and to collapse rules that read it) -- there is no mutation to either object's own state.
